_source: Built from the facts of CBP ruling N355175 (2025-11-12, dev split): CBP held Vietnam. Product written by the agent from the facts, no model draft (D782). Target China (reverse probe: away from a non-China origin); plant capabilities for China and all costs are assumptions. No later ruling on a changed setup, so there is no backtest.

product.name: Fully automatic upper arm blood pressure monitor
product.description: An oscillometric monitor: a PCBA main board with MCU and pressure sensor, an LED display, an air pump and exhaust valve in a plastic housing, packed with a cuff and USB-C cord.

components.name: PCBA main board (SMT, firmware burned, tested)
Air pump, exhaust valve and tubing

operations.name: Calibrate the main board by writing standard pressure values into the MCU
Install the display and main board, the pump module and wiring, and close the housing
Run air-tightness and blood pressure simulation tests, inspect and pack
